features: 4MP parking space detection camera — monitors 6 parking spaces in real time (detection rate >99.5%), 2.8 mm lens
PoE+ and 12 VDC power (PoE variant of ITC414-PH5B-TF2)
recognizes vehicle model, logo, color and plate number; collects metadata for unlicensed vehicles (vehicle recognition >99.5%, plate recognition >99%)
illegal parking detection (vehicle across two spaces, non-allowlist vehicle, small vehicle in large space), line crossing, sound and light alarm with voice broadcast
built-in 7-color parking-space indicator; RS-485 for external indicators (one per space)
True WDR 100 dB, 3D NR, HLC, BLC, digital watermarking; for indoor and semi-enclosed parking
electrically adjustable lens depression angle 10-34 degrees; cable tray mount

frigate.notes: Dahua parking space detector — ONVIF not listed in the datasheet; standard Dahua /cam/realmonitor RTSP path (unverified).

home_assistant.notes: No ONVIF listed in the datasheet; add via Generic Camera with the Dahua RTSP URL.
